overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: MSBA keeps minutes, and the decisive meetings were staff-level meetings with town officials that lacked a quorum of any MSBA body.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that the MSBA and its subcommittees have not kept minutes of their meetings.
allegations.key_passage: The MSBA does keep minutes of its meetings and subcommittee meetings.

allegations.summary: Complaint asked the MSBA to reconvene the subcommittee where the decision to build a co-located middle/high school in Duxbury was made.
allegations.key_passage: Because these meetings did not involve a quorum of a public body, there was no requirement that the participants post notice for or make these meetings open to the public.
